description: The two human-facing index tables have drifted from the authoritative per-spec headers, and two docs cite a file that does not exist. specs/README.md and the root README.md carry status/version columns for the six specs, but each spec's own header is the truth (CLAUDE.md 'Current state'; ROADMAP.md 'Note on drift'): the root README.md still shows KMI as ratified when specs/media-interchange.md is 0.3.0 candidate, and neither table pins KGP 0.5.0 / KFT 0.4.0 / KMI 0.3.0 / KCB 0.3.0 consistently against their headers. Separately, the root CLAUDE.md and specs/fine-tuning.md changelog (around line 555) both cite an ECOSYSTEM.md as 'the living topology,' but no such file exists in koine — topology is deployment instance data that lives in the private integration repo (CLAUDE.md 'What does NOT belong here'). This is the only discrete koine edit in Phase 1 (ROADMAP.md); it is pure doc-sync — no normative spec clause changes, so no spec re-enters validation. Public-safe: bind roles, no product names.
warmup: for s in identity grounding-pack media-interchange capability-bus conformance-scenario fine-tuning; do echo "== $s =="; sed -n '1,12p' specs/$s.md; done
verify: python3 -c "import json,glob; [json.load(open(f)) for f in glob.glob('schemas/*.json')]; print('schemas ok')"
! grep -rIl 'ECOSYSTEM.md' README.md CLAUDE.md specs/*.md decisions/*.md 2>/dev/null | xargs -I{} sh -c 'test -f ECOSYSTEM.md || (echo "dangling ECOSYSTEM.md ref in {}" && exit 1)'

userStories.title: Reconcile the two index tables against the authoritative spec headers
userStories.description: Bring the specs/README.md 'The six protocols' table and the root README.md status table into agreement with each spec's own version+status header, which is authoritative (CLAUDE.md 'Current state', ROADMAP.md 'Note on drift').
acceptanceCriteria: specs/README.md and README.md report, for every one of the six specs, the SAME version+status as that spec's own header: KINP 0.2.1 ratified, KCS 0.2.0 ratified, KGP 0.5.0 candidate, KMI 0.3.0 candidate, KCB 0.3.0 candidate, KFT 0.4.0 candidate — in particular the root README.md no longer shows KMI or any candidate spec as ratified, and KGP/KFT are not shown at their older (0.4.0 / 0.3.0) versions.

Each row states the version number, not only the ratified/candidate glyph, so the tables cannot silently drift from the headers again; wording notes that each spec's header remains the source of truth and these tables are a convenience mirror.
No normative clause in any specs/*.md is changed — this is index-table + prose sync only; no spec version is bumped and no spec re-enters draft/candidate/ratified as a result.

userStories.title: Reconcile the dangling ECOSYSTEM.md references
userStories.description: The root CLAUDE.md and specs/fine-tuning.md changelog (~line 555) both cite an ECOSYSTEM.md 'living topology' file that does not exist in koine, because topology is deployment instance data (CLAUDE.md 'What does NOT belong here'). Resolve the dangling references per ROADMAP.md's Loose-wishlist item.
acceptanceCriteria: Every ECOSYSTEM.md reference in the repo (root CLAUDE.md and specs/fine-tuning.md changelog, plus any other .md that cites it) is resolved one of two ways per the ROADMAP note: either repointed at the private integration repo where deployment topology lives, or backed by a thin, agnostic in-repo index that carries NO instance data (no topology, no bridge/predicate maps, no node/edge ontology) — never left dangling.

If the chosen resolution adds an in-repo file, it is agnostic (binds roles, names no deployment) and CLAUDE.md's 'no spec/schema/registry/policy file may link to the private integration repo' rule is respected: any private-repo pointer lives only in CLAUDE.md / README-level docs, never in a spec, schema, registry, or policy file.
specs/fine-tuning.md's referenced text remains informative-only (no normative change, no version bump), consistent with its changelog note that this is not a normative change.

userStories.title: Internal link + reference integrity across the docs
userStories.description: After the table sync and the ECOSYSTEM.md resolution, confirm every internal Markdown link and spec cross-reference still resolves, so the doc-sync does not leave a new dangling reference.
acceptanceCriteria: Every relative Markdown link in README.md, CLAUDE.md, specs/README.md, decisions/README.md, schemas/README.md, registry/README.md, and ROADMAP.md resolves to an existing file or in-file anchor (no broken relative link introduced or left behind).
The verify link-resolution check passes: no remaining reference to a non-existent ECOSYSTEM.md anywhere in README.md, CLAUDE.md, specs/*.md, or decisions/*.md unless the file now exists.

schemas/*.json still parse (broad smoke) and no spec header, changelog, or normative clause was altered by this tasklist beyond the version/status index tables and the informative ECOSYSTEM references.
